messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#652] Tutorial
parts:
This seems to be a github change. I don't know how familiar with markdown you are, we use R markdown and generate markdown from that with knitr. Github serves the markdown the way they like. The code is in a code block started with ```r and closed by ``` on a separate line with empty lines before and after. From there it's their business. I will raise the issue with them. I don't really like when developers dump responsibility on a library or service that they use, we should always be ultimately responsible for the outcome, but realistically we can't replace github overnight for an issue of code highlighting. I hope they respond quickly.


Antonio

messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#652] Tutorial
parts:
Actially, I raised the issue with them before and they refused to address it. I'll see what I can do. I think developers should be responsible for the code they write and the libraries they use. It's too easy to say, it's that crappy library that breaks my program. In practice, we don't have the resources to help github fix pygment (that's where the original problem lies according to them). We do render html directly and there is some minimal code highlighting in there (http://htmlpreview.github.com/?https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/rmr2/blob/master/docs/tutorial.html). We could fix that (based on knitr) and then serve the html from somewhere else.  Any help in the docs department is very welcome.


Antonio
